objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package. This is design and inventory tooling only: no deletion, no local execution, no paid services. Define a structured audit schema, a discovery procedure, a read-only PowerShell inventory script that can later be run manually on Windows, and an Astra review packet. Update project memory/provenance. The audit script must never delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, or alter files.
constraints: No AI video inference on local PC
No cleanup deletion or uninstall actions
PowerShell script must be read-only and output an inventory report only
acceptance_criteria: With empty AgentOwnedCandidateRoots, the script enumerates zero candidate files and does not recurse ActiveProjectRoot.
Only explicit candidate roots are recursively enumerated.
KEEP_ACTIVE has first precedence for files inside ActiveProjectRoot.
Overlapping candidate roots produce one entry per normalized absolute file path.
Exact provenance is exact normalized absolute path only; no filename or relative-candidate fallback.
Entry schema requires path, size_bytes, last_modified_utc, evidence_source, recommendation, provenance_match, reason.
External candidate files are always review-only, never auto-remove.
Docs/schema/script/review packet are mutually consistent and review_status remains PENDING_ASTRA_REVIEW.
retry_reason: Escalating this correction to the stronger free Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite worker. The prior candidate still recursively scans ActiveProjectRoot, does not enforce KEEP_ACTIVE precedence for candidate roots inside the project, and does not deduplicate overlapping roots.
orchestrator_corrections: Do NOT enumerate ActiveProjectRoot. It is only a protected boundary and provenance-registry base. With AgentOwnedCandidateRoots empty, entries must be empty and no recursive filesystem scan should occur.

Implement a boundary-safe Test-IsInsidePath helper. For every file found in a candidate root, FIRST test whether it is inside ActiveProjectRoot. If yes: KEEP_ACTIVE / ACTIVE_PROJECT, regardless of candidate-root membership or provenance.
Use a case-insensitive HashSet or Dictionary keyed by normalized absolute file path to deduplicate overlapping candidate roots.

Load provenance into a case-insensitive HashSet of exact normalized absolute paths: absolute_path records directly; relative file records joined to ActiveProjectRoot. No filename fallback and no candidate-root-relative matching.

For an external candidate file not inside active project: exact provenance match -> CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY / EXACT_PROVENANCE_MATCH / provenance_match=true; otherwise -> CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY / EXPLICIT_AGENT_OWNED_ROOT / provenance_match=false.
Each entry must include path, size_bytes, last_modified_utc, evidence_source, recommendation, provenance_match, and reason.
Schema must require all entry fields. evidence_source enum must include ACTIVE_PROJECT, EXACT_PROVENANCE_MATCH, EXPLICIT_AGENT_OWNED_ROOT.
Report summary should include total_scanned, keep_active_count, candidate_review_count, exact_provenance_match_count, explicit_root_count.
Script must perform no deletion, uninstall, registry write, service stop, process kill, package removal, or file write. Emit JSON to stdout only.
Docs must explicitly state default invocation scans zero candidate files and ActiveProjectRoot is not recursively enumerated.
Astra packet stays PENDING_ASTRA_REVIEW and accurately describes only implemented behavior.
Use exact model gemini-3.5-flash-lite in all provenance-bearing filenames and metadata for this regenerated candidate.
